name: LotsOfEvents
subtitle: Calendars, reminders & widgets
promotionalText: See your events and reminders together. Plan ahead with a continuous agenda, customizable widgets, and quick entry by typing or dictation.
description:
Bring your calendar and reminders together in one clear view.

LotsOfEvents works with Apple Calendar and Reminders so you can plan your days, manage tasks, and see what comes next without moving your information to a new account.

PLAN YOUR DAYS
Browse your calendar or scroll through a continuous agenda. Create and edit events, search your schedule, and choose the calendars you want to see.

KEEP TASKS ORGANIZED
See dated tasks alongside events in Calendar and Agenda. Complete tasks from the calendar, browse your reminder lists, edit tasks, and arrange lists in the order that works for you.

REMEMBER IMPORTANT DATES
Optionally show birthdays, anniversaries, and other dates from Contacts. These dates repeat annually and stay connected to your local contacts.

SEE MORE WITH WIDGETS
Keep upcoming events and selected reminder lists on your Home Screen. Choose from multiple widget layouts and customize their appearance to suit your style.

ADD THINGS QUICKLY
Type or dictate what you want to add, then adjust the date, time, calendar, or reminder list before saving.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your accent color, light or dark appearance, and text size. Use LotsOfEvents on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with a companion Apple Watch app.

Calendar and reminder access is required to display and manage your existing items. Optional features request permission when needed.
reviewNotes: No LotsOfEvents account or login is required. Grant Calendar and Reminders access when prompted, or connect them in Settings. To test with an empty device, create a calendar/list using Apple Calendar or Reminders, then add sample events and reminders in LotsOfEvents. Quick Add supports typed entry and optional dictation. Widgets can be added from the Home Screen widget gallery. Optional travel alerts, birthday ages, and dictation request their related system permissions. Denying optional permissions does not prevent the core calendar and reminders features. Reminder notifications are sent locally by LotsOfEvents after notification permission is granted. Settings → Alerts controls this feature. Apple Reminders alarms are preserved; users can disable Apple Reminders notifications in system Settings to avoid duplicate alerts. Open LotsOfEvents after changes on another device to refresh scheduled notifications. Optional contact dates can be enabled in Settings → Calendars & Lists → Dates from Contacts. This requests Contacts access and displays birthdays, anniversaries, and custom dates as read-only yearly entries. Dated incomplete reminders from selected lists appear in Calendar; tap the circle to complete a task or its title to edit it. Notification taps open the Reminders tab. The app adapts to iPhone, iPhone Duo, and iPad layouts. Mac has a sidebar, month/week/day views, and a task inspector. Screenshots use fictional sample data; no demo login is needed. Quick Add also supports undated reminders: choose Reminder, then Date → No due date. This overrides typed dates and removes repetition because a repeat schedule requires a due date. Weather features and the WeatherKit entitlement have been removed from all platforms. This version does not use WeatherKit or display Apple Weather data.
